reason: The README describes a DSH plugin whose primary purpose is translating pasted or local images through vision models so text-only models can analyze them, with a direct analysis tool and model settings page.

summaries.zh: 通过视觉模型转录粘贴或本地图片，并为文本模型提供图像分析工具和视觉模型设置页面。
summaries.en: Transcribes pasted or local images through configurable vision models and provides text-only models with image analysis and vision-model settings.

capabilities: Processes pasted images and local image files for analysis
Sends image content to a configured vision-model route for transcription
Provides a vision_analyze tool with optional questions and model selection
Adds a settings page and JSON API for vision-model configuration
